integrity: All proof and finite checks are directly reproducible from the embedded text and standalone program; no claim of outside review, priority confirmation or formal certification.
limitations: Only native-coordinate uniform vertex pairs, m>=2n, and sparse sequences n/m->0 are covered; the exact diameter itself is previously known. An earlier equivalent sparse-permutation stochastic limit may exist.
title: Marked compound-Poisson near-diameter chords of partial permutohedra
